display_long_description:
🔎 Chains Of Clues

Solve crimes in VR. Reconstruct the truth with your own hands.

Step into a fully immersive investigation experience where every detail matters and every decision counts. In Chains Of Clues, you are the detective—tasked with analyzing crime scenes, collecting evidence, and connecting clues to uncover what really happened.

No markers. No hints.
Just you… and the truth.

🧠 INVESTIGATE REAL CRIME SCENES

Explore carefully crafted environments where nothing is random and everything can be a clue.

Observe, analyze, and question every detail. From subtle traces to critical evidence, each element can change your understanding of the case.

🖐 HANDLE EVIDENCE WITH YOUR HANDS

Built for virtual reality, every interaction is physical and intuitive:

Pick up and inspect objects from any angle
Use forensic tools to reveal hidden details
Examine surfaces for traces and clues
Take photos of the scene and key evidence

You’re not clicking through menus.
You’re actively investigating.

🧩 CONNECT THE DOTS IN YOUR OFFICE

Your investigation doesn’t end at the scene.

Return to your office and organize everything you’ve discovered:

Place photos and evidence on your investigation board
Link clues together with pins and connections
Review forensic reports and case data
Build your own theory of what happened

The solution isn’t given to you.
You create it.
